description:
Search for USGS water monitoring sites by state or county.
Site types: ST=stream (default), GW=groundwater, LK=lake, SP=spring.
Includes inactive and historical sites; for sites currently reporting data, use usgs_water_data with state_cd.

county_cd.description: County FIPS: 5 digits ('24031') or 3 digits together with state_cd

site_type.description: Site type: ST (stream, default), GW (groundwater), LK (lake), SP (spring)

state_cd.description: State: two-letter code ('CA', 'TX'), name, or FIPS code

name: usgs_water_sites
